reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real AHA.BHA.PHA Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I really love the SOME BY MI Real AHA-BHA-PHA Sheet Mask! It gently exfoliates and clears out my pores while still feeling soothing and hydrating on my skin. After using it, my face feels smoother, fresher, and looks more refined without any irritation. It’s perfect for keeping my skin clear and glowing. ✨💚
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 SOME BY MI Real AHA-BHA-PHA 面膜！佢可以溫和咁去角質、清理毛孔，用喺皮膚上依然感覺舒緩又保濕。用完之後，成塊面感覺更滑、更清爽，望落更細緻，而且完全冇刺激。佢非常適合用嚟保持皮膚乾淨同有光澤。✨💚
